text:
marta: new proposal: introduce a 'focus mode' for the latency heatmap. idea: when enabled, heatmap collapses to fewer buckets + increases temporal resolution so tails are easier to see. looking for feedback on controls and affordances. owen: neat. UI nit: the focus mode toggle should be reversible without page reload. also show a small baseline indicator: duration of original bucket size so users know the compression applied. keisha: microcopy: avoid 'collapse' since it sounds destructive. maybe 'Focus mode (high resolution)'. add a small 'What changes?' link that opens a modal describing effects. ux-bot: accessibility: ensure the increased temporal resolution still respects color contrast; add keyboard shortcuts to enter/exit focus mode, and provide an aria-live message when mode changes. marta: agreed re wording and keyboard shortcut (press "F" to toggle when chart focused). will prototype modal copy: "Focus mode increases temporal resolution and reduces heatmap bucket width to surface tail events. Not permanent; toggle off to return." owen: suggestion: add a small slider in focus mode for bucket width (1-10) with numeric display. default = 3. also include a 'compare to baseline' overlay that shows original aggregated heatmap at 30% opacity. keisha: accessibility extra: when overlaying baseline, ensure the overlay has pattern fill as well (diagonal lines) for non-color cues. also provide a 'show baseline' checkbox reachable by keyboard. marta: mock note for eng: when focus mode active, show a floating help 'focus tile' near the scrubber that lists: bucket width, temporal resolution, and reset button. code sketch: ```html
Bucket width: 3
``` ux-bot: testing checklist: keyboard shortcut works when chart has focus, screen reader announces "Focus mode enabled: temporal resolution increased", ensure patterned baseline overlay visible in high-contrast mode. marta: will update mocks with pattern overlay + accessibility labels. thanks!
